description: Changes the settings of an automation set up from Cosend’s “Lead capture from ads” recipe, named by id, as its settings page in Cosend does: the settings given replace their values, the rest keep theirs, and the result is saved as a new version. If the automation is switched on, the new settings go live with the save, or the save is refused in words and it keeps running what it ran; if it is off, they wait for it to be switched on. An automation from another recipe, or one written by hand, is refused. Each call needs confirming: without confirmation_token it changes nothing and returns a preview with the settings as Cosend filled them in and its check of them, and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it saves. Returns the new version.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The automation set up from the “Lead capture from ads” recipe whose settings change.

settings.description: The settings to change, as the recipe’s settings form asks them. A setting left out keeps the value it has.

questions.description: Up to three, asked one at a time. Each answer is saved on the contact.
questions.title: Questions

sheet.description: Each lead becomes a row: date, name, phone, then one answer per column.
sheet.title: Google Sheet (optional)

tag.description: Added to the contact at the end.
tag.title: Tag

name: update_lead_capture
title: Change “Lead capture from ads” settings
